plugins.description: Opt-in APEX guard hooks: a Kubernetes Secret read deny and a cloud and cluster mutation guard. The hooks are not in this release yet; they come with the class sync. Disabled until you enable the plugin; once enabled, a hook runs unless its CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY> is false.
